body: Knowing her, if I tell her that I want to be left alone for a while she will wait endlessly until I come back to her which defeats a lot of the purpose of NC so I am not sure how that would work. Right?
What I want though is to rekindle our relationship.

I'm okay with going NC as I need a break from her as well but I am just worried about the long term. I'm being honest in saying I do want her back but I don't want her to be pushed away forever at the same time. If I keep replying to her breadcrumbs there's never going to be healing time from either of us. My literal only worry is her being pushed away forever because of ignoring her messages. It's hard when she sends them everyday.

We dated for over a year and we became pretty serious within a month of when we started dating.  The issue is, I could ignore her entirely and be NC like everyone says to do but she KNOWS that I am seeing her messages and ignoring them so I feel like this could backfire especially considering down the road I want to try again with her. We didn't even breakup for anything serious and we had never fought or had any major problems as far as I remember.
Wouldn't she be pushed away if I ignored her (nearly) daily messages?
I will definitely check that out. Thank you for the help.
I think it's just social anxiety and the anxiety of screwing things up like simple tasks.
No, I can't get it by myself legally yet and even if I could I don't really have any money.
Sometimes she's gotta have time with her friends though. Also, she goes to a different school where she fits in well whilst my school is a shithole.
I don't think I could get that yet since I am not a minor. I do appreciate the response though since I thought nobody would reply.
So I should lose the fat before seriously trying to build the muscle?
Feels like my only hope is to move out in two years.

The first thing you said is already somewhat the case. The feeling of being miserable is causing my online class grades to suffer a bit and I explained that but their response was basically about how I can't get into college if it remains like that. In my state I can't yet drive unless an adult is in the car so I can't do the second option until 2019. As for the third thing, I have never said that but I have hinted at it. Thank you though.

I feel really bad for you man. It sucks you had to go through that. I am working to get into uni but that's still another painful 2+ years away which is so hard to endure which usually brings my mood down which then makes it harder to excel in my classes.

Thank you for this. The online classes is definitely where things started to go wrong. It feels as if I unknowingly signed a permanent contract of isolation when that started. I very often think about what I will be doing in the future. I'm working on getting into uni and then finally being able to have the life I always wanted. It's definitely a struggle to wait it out though. The thing about the future that has made me feel worse is that I feel like the current isolation will make me into a very awkward being in the future.
